root_cause: ApprovalRequest could be created for write/project_generation previews without an executable plan, causing approved TaskRuns to block later with project_generation_plan_missing and contradictory success messaging.
behaviors_changed: ApprovalRequest creation now requires an executable plan for write/patch/project_generation actions.
Phase resume produces an implementation-plan preview instead of a false pending approval when no executable plan exists.
Approved approvals validate the linked draft and executable_plan_ref before creating TaskRun.
Chat approval commands report blocked resume outcomes as blocked, not success.
Natural approval phrases and APROVAR task_run_xxx are handled as approval commands when unambiguous.
Approval target_paths now contain only real paths.
risks: Older callers that relied on generic write approvals must now generate patch_plan, project_generation_plan, or concrete_file_operations first.
Project generation plan is structurally executable but still depends on downstream runtime to derive concrete file operations during execution.
